facts.fact: The WURI Benin project's call for consultants refers to Benin's existing national PKI (an RSA Root CA, a government issuing CA, OCSP, TSA and CRL servers, and a remote signing engine formerly TrustedX) which it asks the firm to upgrade.
facts.system: national PKI (RSA Root CA, Gov CAI)

facts.fact: The WURI Benin project, World Bank financed, is recruiting a firm (six-month mission, submissions due 20 February 2025) to build a new ECC Root CA and an ISO 18013-5 issuing CA and to give Digital ID Wallet users signing and OIDC-federated authentication capabilities.
